assessments.summary: The supplied audit establishes exact tangent-space stationarity and negative definiteness of the Hessian at the interior tensor point in the stated 16-cell fixed-map simplex, so the point is a strict local maximum. Exact tensor-product additivity and the required one-use RTD identification give value 2 L_RTD; min(E_Y,E_Z) <= L_{1/2} then yields the claimed strict inequality for every distinct sufficiently close selected law.
scopeQualifications: The result applies only to the open 16-cell quotient with the four specified deterministic product-code maps and variation solely of the positive masses q(W,X^2).
It does not establish global optimality even within that quotient.
It does not address distant points, activation of other atoms, stochastic or different maps, larger auxiliaries, other two-letter architectures, Marton additivity, or a capacity converse.
